name: Tulip
description: Tulip cups with three pointed petals on straight stems, each with one long leaf, nodding a little out of line.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0 48.5%, var(--color1) 48.5% 51.5%, transparent 51.5%) 0 100% / 100% 56% no-repeat; transform-origin: 50% 100%; -webkit-transform: rotate(@rn(-12, 12, 3)deg); transform: rotate(@rn(-12, 12, 3)deg); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 22%; right: 22%; top: 6%; height: 46%; background: @p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5), var(--color6)); -webkit-clip-path: @var(--cup); clip-path: @var(--cup); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: 56%; width: 30%; height: 40%; border-radius: 0 100% 0 100%; background: var(--color1); transform-origin: 0 100%; -webkit-transform: scaleX(@p(1, -1)); transform: scaleX(@p(1, -1)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
